svg.desc: Observed-order vocabulary growth. How quickly does the accepted corpus encounter new types as tokens accumulate?. K 0.901 · beta 0.675 · R² 0.995. Stable source-path order; power-of-two token checkpoints plus final total. The log–log trend describes this path, not saturation or representativeness.
